steps.text: Bring a large pot of well salted water to a boil.
Slice the garlic thinly and chop the parsley while the water heats.
Add the spaghetti to the boiling water and cook it for 9 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a large pan over low heat, and add the garlic and chili flakes. Let the garlic turn just golden, about 2 minutes.
Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain the spaghetti and toss it in the pan with a splash of that water.
Stir in the parsley, season with salt, and serve right away.
Whisk the flour, sugar and baking powder together in a bowl.
Beat in the eggs and milk until the batter is smooth.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat and pour in a ladle of batter.
Flip the pancake when bubbles appear on top, and cook the other side for about a minute.
Keep going with the rest of the batter, and serve them warm.
Crack the eggs into a bowl with a pinch of salt and beat them well.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, pushing them from the edges to the middle.
Take the pan off the heat while they still look a little wet, sprinkle the chives, and serve.
Chop the onion and garlic, and quarter the tomatoes.
Soften the onion and garlic in the olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and the stock, bring it to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the basil and blend the soup until smooth.
Taste, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.
Halve the avocados, scoop them into a bowl, and mash them with a fork.
Squeeze in the lime juice and add a pinch of salt.
Finely chop the onion, tomato and cilantro, and stir them in.
Taste, add more lime or salt if it needs it, and serve.
